blind.description: A folded bundle of dark brown cloth, representing a monk's hooded robe, neatly squared off. On top of the folds rests a coiled yellowish rope belt forming a loop. Surfaces are continuous, solid, and cloth-textured with realistic fold layers. It sits directly and stably on the floor with no plinth, base, floating elements, or holes.
blind.from_above: A compact, roughly square parcel of dark brown fabric showing the layered edges of cloth and a prominent round yellow rope ring placed atop the central fold.
blind.height_vs_figure: Around 4 inches (10 cm) high and roughly 1.2 feet (35 cm) wide, lying flat on the ground compared to the 5 ft 9 in figure.

notes: gemini note: slightly thicker than catalog proportions
